ConocoPhillips Canada Resources Corp. (2025). Surmont In Situ Oil Sands Project: Directive 054 Submissions & Annual OSCA Report. Commercial Scheme Approval No. 9426HHH; EPEA Approval No. 48263-01-01; Class 1b Disposal Approval No. 10044N. Reporting period 1 January to 31 December 2024. Filed with the Alberta Energy Regulator, 30 June 2025.

Loaded: approved scheme production limit (29,964 m3/d), CPF1 and CPF2 design bitumen capacities (27,000 and 118,000 bbl/d), descriptions for the scheme, phases, NCG co-injection and the butane WASP pilot. Other-values: steam generation design (515 t/h at 84.5% quality; 2,318 t/h at 80%), chart reads of 2024 oil, steam and SOR, well counts, NCG rates and concentration, WASP solvent rates and the stated halving of steam. NOT available: the deck prints no 2024 bitumen production or steam total (only daily-rate charts on slides 7-8, 35-40), so no annual-output and no steam flow row; no energy, fuel gas, electricity, cogeneration, GHG or water-balance numbers; produced-water, saline-water and evaporator flows are charts only (slides 37-38, 43, 45). Skipped: subsurface, geomechanics, seismic, OSCA new-DA appendix, regulatory and compliance tables. Locator convention: slide numbers printed (ConocoPhillips footer), equal to PDF pages. Traps: (1) reporting year 2024 although the file is named 2025; (2) the 29,964 m3/d is a regulatory annual-average limit, while CPF design totals 145,000 bbl/d = 23,053 m3/d; (3) steam design is in t/h at wet steam quality, not CWE m3/d; (4) WASP solvent rate printed in mixed units (m3/d and m3/hr).
